en: Wim Hof, holder of more than twenty-six Guinness World Records...

pause_use: cut on the breath; music bed lifts, whoosh/impact on the cut
en: even after sitting two hours among blocks of ice, his core body temperature doesn't drop by a single degree.

en: In 2014, professors at Radboud University in the Netherlands

pause_use: cut on the breath; music bed lifts, whoosh/impact on the cut
en: injected Wim Hof's body with an E. coli toxin that causes a severe infection.

pause_use: cut on the breath; music bed lifts, whoosh/impact on the cut
en: Inject it into a normal person and they get a high fever and shivering.

pause_use: cut on the breath; music bed lifts, whoosh/impact on the cut

pause_use: cut on the breath; music bed lifts, whoosh/impact on the cut

en: scientifically, how is so much heat generated in our body?

en: There is a secret behind it. That is... Brown Adipose Tissue, or Brown Fat!

pause_use: cut on the breath; music bed lifts, whoosh/impact on the cut
en: Our body has two kinds of fat.

pause_use: cut on the breath; music bed lifts, whoosh/impact on the cut
en: One is White Fat, which stores calories and makes us fat.

pause_use: cut on the breath; music bed lifts, whoosh/impact on the cut
en: The second is Brown Fat. It is packed with iron-rich mitochondria.

pause_use: cut on the breath; music bed lifts, whoosh/impact on the cut
en: These are like furnaces, tiny fire pits, inside our body!

pause_use: cut on the breath; music bed lifts, whoosh/impact on the cut
en: When we do deep breathing and special breathing methods...

pause_use: cut on the breath; music bed lifts, whoosh/impact on the cut
en: signals go out from the brain and this Brown Fat suddenly ignites.

pause_use: cut on the breath; music bed lifts, whoosh/impact on the cut
en: It turns calories directly into pure heat!

pause_use: cut on the breath; music bed lifts, whoosh/impact on the cut
en: In science this is called non-shivering thermogenesis.

pause_use: cut on the breath; music bed lifts, whoosh/impact on the cut
en: That is, without the body shivering, an internal heater switches on!
